title: SkyForge
one_line: Fly a trainer, cargo jet, stealth fighter or helicopter over real South India terrain and land on 29 real airports.
how_to_play: W/S pitch, A/D roll, Q/E rudder, Shift/Ctrl throttle, C camera, L final approach, J land at the nearest runway; or a PS5 / Xbox pad. Follow the green / yellow / red guidance to your runway.
description: A 3D flight simulator over real South India terrain and coastline. Four aircraft, 29 real airports with runway lights and PAPI, routes between airports with a NAV autopilot, ILS approaches, wind and monsoon rain, AI airliners at Bengaluru, a fighter weapons range with gun and missiles, two players on one screen with two pads, colour-coded track guidance with terrain, stall and bank warnings, and a full crash sequence: the pilot ejects under a rainbow parachute while the wreck burns.
